description: Merges a pull request by number, URL, or branch. Returns structured data with merge status, method, URL, and branch deletion status.

account.description: Run this call as another gh account already logged in locally (see `gh auth status`), without switching the active account. Off unless the server's PARE_GITHUB_ALLOWED_ACCOUNTS env lists the account. github.com and ghe.com hosts only. Default: the active account.

auto.description: Enable auto-merge when requirements are met (--auto)

matchHeadCommit.description: Safety check: only merge if HEAD SHA matches this value (--match-head-commit)

number.description: Pull request number, URL, or branch name

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (--repo). Default: current repo.

name: pr-merge
title: PR Merge
